name: claude-root
description: The capabilities this ~/.claude root has accumulated, each packaged as a plugin under features/plugins/, or as a mod under features/mods/, so its boundary is visible and it installs on its own.

plugins.name: rulesets
plugins.description: Compose the rules each Claude Code session and delegate receives from a pool of rule files and a config.yaml of conditional blocks, with flags, toggles, notices, delivery records, check, explain, adopt, eject, and render.

plugins.name: epistemic-marks
plugins.description: Blocks a reply, a delegate report, or an open turn that still carries an unverified epistemic mark, and hands back the resolution each mark takes. Teaches the marks and enforces them as one unit: install it and it works, with nothing to configure and nothing to write.

plugins.name: warden
plugins.description: PreToolUse guards. On the Bash tool, they deny printing a secret-shaped environment variable, reading a secret-shaped path, editing a file in place with a stream editor, waiting on sleep, deleting with rm in place of trash, eval, a bunx run that names no version, a manual run of a check the repository's git hooks already run, and a file search rooted at the disk root or a whole home directory, also refused through the Grep and Glob tools. They ask before curl sends a body or a file to a host outside loopback, before a fetch-and-run command, a shell run with -c, and git commit --amend. On the Agent tool, they deny a spawn that names no model, unless it is a fork or its agent definition pins one, and a critic or Plan spawn on haiku.

plugins.name: harness-config
plugins.description: Configure the Claude Code harness and switch provider profiles without a credential ever entering the repository. Ships the policy floor and its alignment machinery, a profile format whose only credential field is a path to a helper script, activation as a bounded write, value-free diagnostics, and guards that verify every settings variant stays out of git.

plugins.name: planning
plugins.description: Holds the planning loop as a skill.

plugins.name: context-gauge
plugins.description: A colored, multi-layer context-usage gauge under the prompt
